questions.question: Timbre differentiates two sounds that have the same pitch and loudness by their: a). Duration b). Harmonic content and spectral envelope c). Speed d). Temperature

questions.question: Assertion (A): Directional microphone arrays in hearing aids reduce noise by physically blocking sound waves. Reason (R): Directional microphone B arrays improve the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) by focusing their sensitivity toward a target speaker and spatially nulling sounds from other directions. a). Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation for A b). Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation for A c). A is true, but R is false d). A is false, but R is true
questions.solution_html: • Directional microphone assertion → A is false, R is true

questions.question: Why is low-latency audio processing crucial in games? a). To ensure sound events coincide with player actions for believable interactivity and feedback b). To reduce file size c). To increase reverberation d). To save CPU at the cost of responsiveness

questions.question: High cognitive load during listening tasks commonly reduces: a). Speech intelligibility and working memory performance b). Eye colour c). Hearing thresholds only d). None of the above

questions.question: When simulating a sound at a given azimuth in headphones, convolving the source with HRTFs for left and right ear ensures: a). Mono playback b). Proper interaural spectral and level differences to create directional cues c). Lossless compression d). Elimination of reverberation

questions.question: How are Shepard tones constructed? B a). By mixing multiple sine waves that are multiples of the fundamental. b). By superimposing complex tones separated by octaves, whose amplitude envelopes overlap and fade in/out smoothly. c). By removing all spectral content. d). By using only bone conduction.
questions.solution_html: • Shepard tone construction → Overlapping octave tones

questions.question: Which audiometric pattern indicates a conductive component? a). Air conduction thresholds equal bone conduction thresholds (no gap). b). questions.question: Assertion (A): The most effective noise control strategy is always simply reducing the overall d B SPL level. Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation for A b). Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation for A c). A is true, but R is false d). A is false, but R is true

questions.question: A lesion in the cochlear nerve would most directly produce which deficit? a). Conductive loss with normal bone conduction b). Sensorineural loss with elevated air and bone thresholds c). Purely vestibular symptoms d). Increased cerumen production

questions.question: When designing an alarm for a noisy factory floor, it must be: a). Quiet, low-pitched, and easily masked b). Highly salient with an irregular temporal pattern c). Identical to the background noise d). Purely visual [2x15 = 30] B
